ops.text: BEFORE upgrade — snapshot the App-Group-data (cc-pool daemon) and AppBundles/Automation (cookiesync) TCC rows from BOTH user and system TCC.db. Note client (path or bundle id), client_type (1=path-keyed/re-prompts, 0=bundle/durable), auth_value (2=allowed), and whether a row exists at all.
ops.command: for db in "$HOME/Library/Application Support/com.apple.TCC/TCC.db" "/Library/Application Support/com.apple.TCC/TCC.db"; do echo "== $db"; sudo sqlite3 "$db" "SELECT service, client, client_type, auth_value FROM access WHERE service IN ('kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppData','kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppBundles','kTCCServiceAccessibility') AND (client LIKE '%cc-pool%' OR client LIKE '%cookiesync%' OR client LIKE '%CCPool%' OR client LIKE '%CookieSync%');"; done
